_methodology.purpose: Maps policy-supported recommendation candidates to the 33 survey questions used to characterise the privacy personas.
_methodology.important: The persona z-scores are observed survey measurements. The mapping itself is researcher-defined and should remain reviewable.
_methodology.multi_signal_rule: A recommendation may use several relevant questions. Direct mappings receive full mapping weight, supporting mappings receive reduced weight, and contextual mappings are explanation-only.
_methodology.domain_balance: Signals are combined within each survey domain first, then domain scores are averaged so a domain does not dominate merely because more questions were mapped to it.

direction.high: A higher-than-average response makes this recommendation more relevant.
direction.low: A lower-than-average response makes this recommendation more relevant. The z-score is reversed for scoring.

_methodology.individual_comfort_note: QCT_7-QCT_9 are concern-worded questions. Their individual z-scores remain in their original question direction. They were only sign-reversed in the research when forming the aligned domain-level Comfort aggregate.
